Find Hogni Truthseeker.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find the home of [[Hogni Truthseeker]] in [[Drakkar Lake]].
* Speak with Hogni Truthseeker

===Reward===
* 100 [[Norn rank|Norn reputation points]]
* {{skill icon|"I Am the Strongest!"}}

Note: 
The quest will only be available after completing "[[Tracking the Nornbear]]" quest.

==Walkthrough==
Start from either [[Olafstead]] or [[Sifhalla]] to get to Hogni Truthseeker. The route from Olafstead is shorter. It is entirely possible to [[Running|run]], as this quest requires no fighting.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
*{{rt}} 20 (20) [[Hogni Truthseeker]]  

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Gunnar Poundfist'''
:''"Every sun that sets behind the mountains draws us closer to an epic battle. We revel in the knowledge that the spirits grant us worthy foes. Yet, there is still much to learn should you seek glory at our sides. If you have received the gifts of the spirits in the past, you will know what I mean. Let me tell you how to make these skills permanent.''
:''Within '''Drakkar Lake''' lives a great Norn named '''Hogni Truthseeker'''. In his day, Hogni was without peer. He slew the most terrible creatures with naught but the strength of his arms. Having bested all its beasts, Hogni now seeks to live in harmony with the natural world. He has retreated to the wilds, isolating himself in the pursuit of knowledge. Go now, <name>. Learn from the greatest hero of our time. With knowledge comes power."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Power, hmmm? I like the sound of that.
|decline = I don't need to learn about flower power.
|ask = You will find '''Hogni''' in the remotest section of '''Drakkar Lake'''. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Hogni Truthseeker'''
:''"You come seeking knowledge, little one? It is true I was once a Warrior of some renown, and doubtless there are skills you could learn. But my lessons this day will not be filled with tactics and stratagems. I shall, instead, force you to open your eyes so you may feel more alive than you ever imagined. I warn you: The lessons are hard learned. If you survive, you will have the blessings of Raven, Wolf, and Bear, and you shall know what it is to be a Norn. Come now. Let us begin."''

==Notes==
*Hogni Truthseeker gives you three quests ([[A Hunter's Pride]], [[Leader of the Pack]] and [[Shadows in the Night]]) to gain the [[elite|elite]] [[form|form]] skills [[Ursan Blessing|Ursan]], [[Volfen Blessing|Volfen]] and [[Raven Blessing|Raven]] blessings as well as Norn reputation points.
**The quests for each skill only become available after completing the primary quest in which you receive the corresponding temporary blessing: [[Blood Washes Blood]] (Ursan), [[Curse of the Nornbear]] (Volfen) and [[A Gate Too Far]] (Raven).
